digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / LLM review overlay system
propositions: T13 plan-review criterion trigger lexicon must be widened from prohibition-only to additive-obligation vocabulary to catch contracts/invariants/schema fields/required arguments added across multiple discharge sites

The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py must include additive-obligation phrasings ('callers must', 'must stay in sync', 'new contract', 'adds a required') or newly applicable plans are silently skipped before router evaluation

Historical content-triggered surface-parity widening to NDJSON/import channel would have yielded 70% false positives; the demonstrated true-positive family (write-parameter parity) is now covered deterministically by write_parity_contract.py oracle

Import-integrity checking must be deterministic (full importlib walk of rebar.* in wheel-probe venv plus scripts/ import leg) rather than LLM-based, as syntactic module presence is machine-verifiable and the LLM channel adds no value over CI

The five-file scope (T13 prompt, routing config, det-gate rule, unit tests, regenerated guide) must be held in isolation; P0 deferred to deterministic import-walk task, P3 rejected as deterministically measurable, ci-gate-compat rejected per prior operator ruling
